overview.description: The EA Bridgeway Ultra-Small Company Market ETF (BUSM) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in micro cap equity. The fund is an actively managed fund that invests in ultra-small cap companies listed in the United States. BUSM was launched on Jul 24, 2026 and is issued by Alpha Architect.

holdings.infoBox: BUSM is an equity ETF with a total of 556 individual holdings. The top holdings are Flexsteel Industries stock at 0.63%, The Honest Company at 0.60%, Smart Sand at 0.59%, RCM Technologies at 0.58%, and Friedman Industries at 0.55%.
